vis.scope: Mutable MS paths; all 101 current cases agree on MAIN, task HISTORY and observed error/trial setup and mutation. Full path/coercion forms and remaining error domains stay on #1518.

field.scope: Default and PHASE field selection preserve unselected rows. Complete FIELD grammar and combinations remain to be CASA compared.

spw.scope: Ranges, strides, overlapping channel ranges, selected fields, both endians, existing/new corrected data and descending MS grids now agree in common modes. Remaining selection domains and mode combinations stay open.

intent.scope: Native STATE grammar handles exact comma-separated OBS_MODE components, patterns, quoted patterns, regexes, intersections, IDs/ranges/bounds, flagged states, and partial numeric lists. Scalar literal text is preserved, including none. Intent remains active with selectdata=False. Current same-input cases pass; full callable/coercion and cross-parameter domains remain.

selectdata.scope: When false, applycal accepts and ignores timerange/uvrange/antenna/scan/observation/msselect while retaining their original inputs for HISTORY. Field, SPW and intent still select. Public CASA comparisons pass; complete remaining API/coercion domains stay open.

timerange.scope: Native time selection exists; full CASA grammar, boundaries and combinations remain in #1518.

uvrange.scope: Native UV-distance selection supports meter/km, lambda/klambda, default units, bounds/ranges, mixed-unit unions and whitespace; CASA comparisons cover combined selection, disabled values and errors/empty results. Full callable/coercion and cross-parameter domains remain.

antenna.scope: Native antenna/baseline selection exists; full grammar, baseline forms and public-state comparisons remain.

scan.scope: Native scan selection exists; remaining grammar, combinations and errors need CASA evidence.

observation.scope: Native observation selection exists; all supported forms and combinations remain to be compared.

msselect.scope: Native TaQL selection exists; full CASA-supported forms, errors and mutation scope remain.

docallib.scope: Shared Rust callibrary support exists; complete activation/inactive-argument semantics and state need evidence.

callib.scope: Shared Rust parsing exists; full per-slice selection/reach/observation/antenna maps and CASA behavior remain.

gaintable.scope: Same-input scalar G and channelized B cases, native BPOLY/K checks and flagged-gain handling. Complete existing-family domains/chains, list/scalar forms and errors remain; future families retain their named owners.

gainfield.scope: Existing exact/nearest mapping and native tests; full CASA field grammar, list alignment and boundary behavior remain.

interp.scope: Existing nearest/linear time modes and nearest,linear; B default frequency interpolation masks flagged samples and uses amplitude/unwrapped phase. Prepared grids are indexed directly, including descending MS bins. Complete interpolation domains remain.

spwmap.scope: Existing explicit maps and native planning checks; full CASA mapping domains/chains and errors remain.

calwt.scope: Reset from SIGMA/SIGMA_SPECTRUM, repeated-call idempotence, selected spectral lower median, unchanged disabled weights and BPOLY-disabled scaling. B uses unflagged full-band power. Complete family/chain/state domains remain.

parang.scope: Standalone circular and full four-correlation linear feed rotation, selected channels, input-flag propagation, trial/flag-only modes and invalid two-linear-correlation error/state match CASA. Full chain/geometry/domain combinations remain.

applymode.scope: All six modes are implemented and CASA-compared, including unavailable SPWs, flag-only preservation, selected channels, new/existing corrected data and trial validation. Empty selections error in every native mode. Full remaining parameter/error combinations stay open.

flagbackup.scope: Backup is saved before selection/table validation in flag-writing modes, including rejected requests, matching CASA. Existing native restore checks and public backup counts pass. Full version contents/metadata and remaining API/error combinations remain.

behaviors.title: Apply chains while preserving unselected data and calibrated weight semantics
behaviors.scope: G/B common application, all six modes, HISTORY, standalone linear/circular parang and intent/UV selection are implemented in bounded batches. Full 21-parameter/common-engine acceptance remains on #1518.
behaviors.gap: Full callibrary/gainfield/interpolation/SPW-mapping and remaining selection/coercion/error and existing-family/chain/state/interchange domains remain. Detailed performance tuning and final qualification follow functionality equivalence under owner direction on #979.

oracle.scope: Full current 101-case corpus with no skipped comparisons: MAIN, complete HISTORY, return/error catchability and backup counts; native/CASA readback and both byte orders. This run uses a debug native CLI for functional evidence, with no performance acceptance claim.
oracle.result: All 101 current MAIN/API/state comparisons pass; full 21-parameter value-domain acceptance remains unfinished on #1518.

source.scope: Calibrater::correct2, task_applycal.py/mstools.write_history, PJones::syncMeta2/calcOneJones, Jones flag propagation/inversion, VisEquation::collapse2, SIGMA reset, CTPatchedInterp frequency interpolation, BJones::calcWtScale and BPOLY::setApply. BPOLY loading samples only planned applicable SPW grids. MSStateGram/MSStateIndex and task selection activation, literal scalar text and selection-error setup.
source.result: All six modes, full task history, inverse linear-feed rotation and flags, trial validation and unavailable solver priors follow source laws, alongside the delivered channel/weight conventions. Review found an unavailable-BPOLY grid error; ordinary/strict/trial application and solver preapply regressions fail before and pass after the fix. Intent grammar, inactive argument retention, rejected-call corrected-column initialization/backups and empty-selection errors follow independent source and CASA comparisons.

performance.scope: Historical 175 MB, 12000 rows, 6144000 complex samples; one worker, five alternating public-Python pairs per cache policy, predating completed HISTORY/modes. Full 21-parameter/state equivalence remains unfinished; final matched qualification follows functionality.
performance.result: Scalar gain reuse reduces compute median 0.228→0.077 s warm and 0.213→0.076 s cold. Full native 0.661 s warm/0.624 s cold versus CASA 0.259/0.349 s: still slower and CPU-limited. Gross repeated sampling is corrected; detailed tuning and final qualification follow functionality equivalence under owner direction on #979.
